panels.description: Number of active lock conflicts (blocker→blocked pairs).

url_options.data:
WITH q AS (
WITH c AS (
  SELECT t, CAST(count(value) AS DOUBLE) AS n
  FROM prom_last(('pgwatch_lock_waits_blocked_ms'), ([['cluster', '=', '${cluster_name}'], ['node_name', '=', '${node_name}'], ['datname', '=~', '${db_name:regex}']]),
         (CAST((${__from} - ${__from} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) AS BIGINT)))
  GROUP BY t
)
SELECT g.t, coalesce(c.n, 0) AS value
FROM (SELECT unnest(range((CAST((${__from} - ${__from} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)) + 1, (CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) AS BIGINT)))) AS t) g
LEFT JOIN c USING (t)
)
SELECT CAST(q.t AS BIGINT) AS time, CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE) AS value, 'Lock conflicts' AS series, '' AS label_set
FROM q
WHERE q.value IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE))
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Lock conflicts

panels.description: How long sessions have been waiting for locks.

url_options.data:
WITH q AS (
SELECT prom_by(labels, list_transform(([]::VARCHAR[][]), lambda k: CAST(k AS VARCHAR))) AS labels, t,
       CASE ('avg') WHEN 'sum' THEN sum(value) WHEN 'avg' THEN avg(value)
            WHEN 'count' THEN CAST(count(value) AS DOUBLE) WHEN 'min' THEN min(value) WHEN 'max' THEN max(value) END AS value
FROM prom_last(('pgwatch_lock_waits_blocked_ms'), ([['cluster', '=', '${cluster_name}'], ['node_name', '=', '${node_name}'], ['datname', '=~', '${db_name:regex}']]),
       (CAST((${__from} - ${__from} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) AS BIGINT)))

GROUP BY 1, 2
)

FROM q

panels.title: By table

panels.description: Current blocking relationships with process details.

url_options.data:
WITH q AS (
SELECT labels, t, value
FROM prom_last(('pgwatch_lock_waits_blocked_ms'), ([['cluster', '=', '${cluster_name}'], ['node_name', '=', '${node_name}'], ['datname', '=~', '${db_name:regex}']]),
       (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % ${__interval_ms}) AS BIGINT)), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % ${__interval_ms}) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(${__interval_ms} AS BIGINT)))
)
SELECT CAST(q.t AS BIGINT) AS "Time", q.labels['blocked_appname'] AS "blocked_appname", q.labels['blocked_locktype'] AS "blocked_locktype", q.labels['blocked_mode'] AS "blocked_mode", q.labels['blocked_pid'] AS "blocked_pid", q.labels['blocked_query_id'] AS "blocked_query_id", q.labels['blocked_table'] AS "blocked_table", q.labels['blocked_user'] AS "blocked_user", q.labels['blocker_appname'] AS "blocker_appname", q.labels['blocker_locktype'] AS "blocker_locktype", q.labels['blocker_mode'] AS "blocker_mode", q.labels['blocker_pid'] AS "blocker_pid", q.labels['blocker_query_id'] AS "blocker_query_id", q.labels['blocker_table'] AS "blocker_table", q.labels['blocker_user'] AS "blocker_user", q.labels['cluster'] AS "cluster", q.labels['datname'] AS "datname", q.labels['dbname'] AS "dbname", q.labels['env'] AS "env", q.labels['instance'] AS "instance", q.labels['job'] AS "job", q.labels['node_name'] AS "node_name", q.labels['real_dbname'] AS "real_dbname", q.labels['sink_type'] AS "sink_type", q.labels['sys_id'] AS "sys_id", CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE) AS "Value"
FROM q
WHERE q.value IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN cardinality(q.labels) = 1 THEN map_values(q.labels)[1] ELSE '{' || array_to_string(list_transform(list_sort(map_keys(q.labels)), lambda k: k || '="' || q.labels[k] || '"'), ', ') || '}' END
